title: [GMCP 203.009.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Complete tool server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-009-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Tool discovery, deterministic pagination/filtering, list-change signaling, invocation, structured and unstructured results, output-schema validation, annotations, icons, errors, cancellation, progress, caching, idempotency declarations, and concurrent execution all work through the production registry. Tool identity and schema changes are versioned, calls are policy-gated, and success is impossible when declared output contracts are violated. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
